verdict.rationale: The only payments evidence is a page title, 'Ecommerce Payment Providers & Credit Card Solutions'. It points to third-party payment providers and documents no first-party integrated processing, published card rates, payouts, or fraud tooling. Integrated payments is a fair question for an ecommerce platform, so the axis applies, but the pack does not show the capability.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can take payments with the platform's integrated processing — published card rates, payouts, and fraud tooling — without wiring a third-party gateway
